generationInputs.prompt: A luminous pink donut sits centrally against a light pink background. Dripping from the donut's base is pink liquid. Adorning the donut are numerous diamonds and pink sprinkles. Emerging from the donut's center are two female legs, clad in black fishnet stockings and black high-heeled shoes. Two hands also extend from the donut, one holding a syringe with glowing liquid and the other holding a glass pipe. The overall impression is one of lightness and airiness, the donut appearing almost weightless, with a dreamlike, slightly otherworldly quality due to the holographic effect of the icing. The light pink background softly complements the donut's color, maintaining a feeling of delicate sweetness and ethereal beauty.
